item.title: The Garden of Unearthly Delights is back! Here’s this year’s top shows to check out
item.description: The Garden of Unearthly Delights is headed back to Rundle Park once again for Fringe, delivering its most ambitious season yet with world-class shows and star-studded food experiences.

item.title: Gluttony unveils its biggest-ever food lineup, with fine dining pop-ups, celebrity chefs and a Champagne island
item.description: Gluttony is levelling up Fringe dining in 2026 with its largest-ever food and beverage offering, featuring new pop-up restaurants, expanded street-food precincts and iconic bars across Rymill Park.

item.title: FRINGE: ‘HAUS of YOLO’ heads to Adelaide with sequins, sideshow and some serious sass
item.description: The Dust Palace brings its glitter-soaked, fashion-fuelled spectacle HAUS of YOLO to Adelaide Fringe for a fierce Australian premiere packed with aerial couture, queer joy and jaw-dropping acrobatics.

item.title: Inner-west favourite ‘Pony and Cole’ welcomes bold new autumn art exhibition and hands-on workshops
item.description: Pony and Cole is welcoming autumn with Colour Theory, a new exhibition by Pria Mitra that blends art, creativity and hands-on workshops inside its converted warehouse space.

item.title: Celebrate women ‘Raising the Bar’ this International Women’s Day at the Strathmore Hotel
item.description: Adelaide’s Strathmore Hotel will host an International Women’s Day long lunch celebrating women in the drinks industry while raising funds for Catherine House.

item.title: Top 10 Events in Adelaide this March
item.description: The festival season is in full swing, and the streets of Adelaide are well and truly alive. Here's our top 10 events in Adelaide this March.

item.title: Rolled ice cream store ‘Scroll’d’ makes grand return with festival pop-up
item.description: Scroll'd is back offering your favourite ice cream flavours rolled up at festival events

item.title: Popular northern Adelaide restaurant New Century reopens with a fresh interior, new menu & robot waiter
item.description: A Mawson Lakes favourite reopens its doors after a 5-week renovation with fresh new additions and plans to introduce robot waiter.

item.title: FIRST LOOK: Angry Penguin is Adelaide Festival Centre’s new restaurant with avant-garde ’70s flair
item.description: With Chef Alex Katsman at the helm, Angry Penguin pairs refined, seasonal menus with river views, iconic art and a dining room built for theatrics.

item.title: Adelaide weather forecast for Saturday February 21st and the days ahead
item.description: Adelaide’s heat peaks today, before showers, thunderstorms and a cooler change sweep through, with severe weather possible across parts of South Australia.
